messages:
DeployBot: :warning: preflight failed for release v2.14.3 -> env-parity: ENV_PAYLOAD mismatch between staging and prod. Promotion blocked.
Ashley: noticed this during the pre-promote smoke. what does the diff look like?
Samir: staging ENV_PAYLOAD (structured): `{
  "ingress": {"timeout": 30},
  "cache": {"enabled": true, "ttl": 1200}
}`
Samir: prod ENV_PAYLOAD (ssm string): `"{\"ingress\":\"30\",\"cache\":true}"` -> ttl missing and numbers are strings.
Mira: that explains the parser errors we saw in canary logs: runtime attempted int ops on strings and hit fallback codepath.
Devin: timeline: when did we land the ENV_PAYLOAD normalization? It was in the "env-loader -> structured" change last week.
Ashley: merged in canary branch on Tuesday; staging got it but prod's param store looks like it never had the migration applied.
Leo: possible cause: legacy deployer used old SSM key prefix `prod.env` vs `prod-p0.env` and the migration script skipped it.
OpsOncall: change window in 90m (18:30 local). we can either pause promotion or proceed with mitigation.
Mira: options: 1) rollback prod to previous image (safe, quick) 2) temp tolerant parse shim in runtime (fast but could mask bug) 3) backfill SSM entries to structured JSON (one-off, needs caution).
Samir: also: tokenization path might change if cache.ttl absent -> cache disabled -> token cost increases. good chance of customer-facing latency increase.
Devin: do we know which tenants are impacted?
Ashley: three high-throughput tenants on dedicated pools, plus all hosted requests hitting model-router.
Leo: on balance, rollback + backfill in change window seems lowest risk. we avoid touching runtime.
OpsOncall: concur. suggest rollback now, create a release note pin, run backfill in change window after verification in staging.
Mira: agree. also add an automated pre-promote check that validates SSM param schema and rejects stringified values.
Samir: if we rollback, let's also pin the model and config metadata so deploybot doesn't auto-promote v2.14.3. add metadata: `{"pin":"v2.13.9", "hold_reason":"ENV_PAYLOAD schema mismatch"}`
Ashley: adding a manual hold and updating release notes. I'll paste the PR once done.
Devin: i'll write a small idempotent backfill tool: pseudo: `for k in prod_keys: v = get(k); if is_stringified_json(v): set(k, parse(v))` with dry-run mode. will run in staging first.
Leo: include a checksum comparison so we can revert if backfill produces unexpected changes.
Mira: add unit tests covering both "30" -> 30 and missing ttl -> default ttl 600. fail the build if schema changes.
OpsOncall: any objections to rollback now?
Samir: none. +1
Devin: +1
Leo: +1
Ashley: performing manual rollback to v2.13.9. DeployBot: please mark release blocked until manual unhold.
DeployBot: Manual rollback triggered by Ashley. Reverting prod to v2.13.9. Promotion paused.
DeployBot: NOTE: reason="ENV_PAYLOAD schema mismatch (stringified vs structured)" metadata={"pin":"v2.13.9","blocked_by":"manual"}
Ashley: opened PR for release notes and pin: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/4378
Devin: will open backfill + tests PR targeting the 18:30 change window. i'll include staging dry-run logs.
Mira: updating runbook to add a pre-promote SSM schema validator and a checklist entry to verify param prefixes.
Leo: once backfill + tests pass we can remove the pin and rerun preflight; if green, promote.
OpsOncall: i'll watch prod metrics for 30m post-rollback and report any regressions here.
Ashley: thanks all. closing thread pending oncall signoff.
DeployBot: Rollback complete: v2.13.9 active in prod. v2.14.3 remains on hold.
